name: Rest Camp
description: The long exhale between fights — a full party resource reset, priced in risk. Resting restores health and per-rest abilities in one shot, because a rest that half-works teaches players to rest twice, and per-rest abilities then collapse into per-fight abilities with extra clicks. The price is the ambush roll: biome, recent noise, and whether a watch was posted feed a probability that world.mob_patrol or a dynamic spawner converts into an actual interruption. This component owns the rest transaction and the risk roll. It does not own the ambush itself, and it never touches inventory — rations spent while camping go through inventory.slotted_bag like anywhere else.

inputs.name: restDurationSeconds
inputs.description: Real time the rest takes. Long enough to feel like a commitment, short enough to not be a loading screen with a campfire.

inputs.name: baseAmbushChance
inputs.description: Ambush probability before modifiers. 0.15 is often enough to make posting a watch a habit, rare enough that resting stays worth it.

inputs.name: requiresSafeZone
inputs.description: Whether rest is restricted to designated campsites. True is the hardcore mode; false lets the ambush chance carry the entire risk budget.

inputs.name: restoresPerRestAbilities
inputs.description: Whether per-rest ability charges come back. The whole point of the component; exposed so a survival variant can say no.

outputs.name: lastRestOutcome
outputs.description: completed | interrupted — for camp UI and analytics.

outputs.name: ambushChance
outputs.description: The computed probability for the pending rest, shown to the player before committing.
